# Acefold

> Acefold is a full service Amazon PPC and advertising agency for premium brands doing $50,000 a month and up on Amazon. It manages Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display and Amazon DSP, listing SEO, product launches and monthly profit reporting, and judges every account by profit after ad spend rather than ACoS alone.

Acefold LLC is run by Amazon PPC operators who have managed eight figure ad spend across more than twenty Amazon accounts. Work is not billed by the hour. New clients start with a free 90 minute account audit.

## Services

- [PPC and DSP](https://acefold.com/#services): Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Video, Sponsored Display and Amazon DSP, structured by buyer intent with daily bid management and negative keyword control.
- [Listings and SEO](https://acefold.com/#services): keyword mapping, indexation, titles, bullets, backend terms, A+ Content and main image testing to lift conversion rate.
- [Launches and catalog operations](https://acefold.com/#services): launch pacing, ranking velocity, variation strategy, Brand Store and day to day Seller Central work.
- [Profit and reporting](https://acefold.com/#services): monthly reporting on profit after ad spend, ACoS, TACoS and conversion rate, with the reasoning behind every change.

## Case studies and results

Client names and identifiers are withheld and figures are adjusted for confidentiality. Projections are labeled as projections.

- [Case 01, specialty home and building products](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-1): monthly sales from $37,800 to $151,600 (+301.1%), monthly profit up 366.7%, 23.1% ACoS.
- [Case 02, home and kitchen](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-2): main image A/B test lifted conversion rate 29.8% (0.114% to 0.148%).
- [Case 03, home and garden, seasonal](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-3): monthly sales from $17,840 to a $44,790 peak (+151.1%) at 29.7% blended ACoS.
- [Case 04, sports and outdoors](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-4): monthly sales from $36,820 to $92,470 in one quarter, average organic rank from 58 to 24.
- [Case 05, grocery and gourmet](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-5): monthly sales from $19,720 to a $36,810 peak (+86.7%) at 28.97% ACoS.
- [Case 06, pet supplies, seasonal](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-6): monthly sales from $71,200 to $115,400, 100+ keywords on page one, 21.7% blended ACoS.
- [Case 07, sports and outdoors](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-7): main image A/B test lifted conversion rate 20.3% and sales from search 31.7%.
- [Case 08, home and office](https://acefold.com/case-studies.html#case-8): main image tests across five products, a projected $183,810 annual sales uplift.
- [All results by category](https://acefold.com/results.html)
